name: Yobai Mania
source:
Choose one of three male characters and infiltrate a mansion. Avoid the traps and guards to pave the way to the cutest girls of the town.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从三名男性角色中选择一人，潜入一座宅邸。避开陷阱与守卫，设法接近镇上最可爱的女孩们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
